reasoning: The icon is a standard pilcrow (¶), universally used in word processors and typography to represent a paragraph or text formatting marks. While originally a UI toggle for hidden characters, it serves well as a distinctive shorthand for writing, editing, proofreading, and typesetting tasks, though it may occasionally be confused with the pi symbol.
